title: Nextera XT at 0.2X On the Mantis
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Leave caps off of falcon tubes
Empty the waste tube from the Waste Station.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL of 70% EtOH in a 250 mL reagent bottle (to be done weekly).

steps.title: Maintain Wash Station Tubes
steps.instruction: Clean and rotate the wash tubes between stations.

substeps.instruction: Remove the 'WASH' tube from Wash Station 1 (right side) and discard leftover EtOH.
Rinse the wash tube by spraying with RNAse away and 70% EtOH, then move the tube to Wash Station 2.
Remove the 'WASH' tube from Wash Station 2 (left side) and replace it with the tube taken from Wash Station 1.
Transfer 4 mL of 70% EtOH to the 'WASH' tube taken from Wash Station 2.
Place the tube in Wash Station 1, ensuring the line feeds to the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Load Mantis Wash Protocol
steps.instruction: Load the MANTIS wash protocol software.

steps.title: Prime Chips with NFdH2O
steps.instruction: Prime the used chips using NFdH2O.

substeps.instruction: Load the used TD chip with a new 1000 uL tip containing 150 uL of NFdH2O.
Load other used chips (ATM, NT, NPM) with new 200 uL tips containing 150 uL of NFdH2O.
Select a chip by clicking on the associated input number (highlighted in grey) for the MANTIS to pick up the chip.
Manually prime each chip by holding the 'Manual Prime' button until all NFdH2O has run through.
Discard the tips after priming.

steps.title: Wash Chips with 70% EtOH
steps.instruction: Flush the chips with 70% EtOH to clean them.

substeps.instruction: Load each chip with an empty 1000 uL tip.
Click 'Wash All Inputs' to flush each chip with 70% EtOH from Wash Station 1.
Carefully discard the tips once the chips are detached from the Mantis.
Repeat the wash at least once using new tips each time.
Manually prime each chip by holding the 'Manual Prime' button until all 70% EtOH has run through.

steps.title: Dry Chips and Clean Pallets
steps.instruction: Remove chips for drying and clean the magnetic pallets.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove chips from magnetic chip pallets and place them in designated open falcon tubes to dry.
Apply gentle pressure under the chip to remove it, avoiding touching the nozzle.
Clean each magnetic chip pallet with 70% EtOH and Kimwipes.

steps.title: Clean Chip Port Stations
steps.instruction: Perform final cleaning of the port stations and waste tube.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the inside of each chip port station with 70% EtOH and Kimwipes or cotton-tipped applicators.
Rinse the waste tube by spraying with RNAse away and 70% EtOH, then return the tube to the Waste Station.
